newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent off with weaker NYMEX after API/EIA.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent off with weaker NYMEX after API/EIA.

text.p: Brent crude futures fell in Asia on Friday after a rise in U.S. crude and distillate stocks.
However, brokers said weather would remain the main focus short term as there appears to be no let up in the European freeze.

February Brent on SIMEX traded down to a low of $24.05, down 17 cents from London's settlement overnight. Brokers said the fall was in line with a weaker NYMEX, which extended New York's decline on the after-hours ACCESS system.
NYMEX February crude dropped 23 cents in New York and added a further 19 cents to the downside in Asia -- but found support at Thursday's NYMEX low of $25.50.
By late afternoon, prices had pared losses, leaving February Brent at $24.15 and NYMEX at $25.65.

The weakness, came after the API and EIA inventory data released in the U.S. on Thursday. Both showed a large build in crude and distillates when a draw and modest build had been expected respectively.
